summary:
Retest of the HIGH-priority image-toolbar bug (iter45). Backend pytest 49/49 GREEN across the 4 required suites, plus 7/7 iter45 e2e still green (56/56 total). Backend fix _wrap_standalone_images() is correctly applied — verified on real Paloma DOCX: 2 previously-bare cover-page images now emit as `

` and the API returns wrapCount=2 imgCount=4 (the docx-header logo and the in-table-cell decorator image are correctly left alone). HOWEVER the Image contextual toolbar still does NOT appear when clicking a DOCX-imported image in the editor — same HIGH-priority failure surface as iter45 but with different root cause now. The fix made the images selectable (img.ProseMirror-selectednode class IS applied on click — a real improvement over iter45), but the React toolbar container conditioned on editor.isActive('image') is NOT re-rendering when the NodeSelection changes. Concretely: after clicking the peacock/logo image, selectednode class present in DOM=True, [data-testid=image-toolbar] in DOM=False, whereas [data-testid=table-add-col-after] (table toolbar) IS in DOM (residual from initial cursor-in-table state that never re-rendered away). Table toolbar cell-click flow still works. All other regression paths pass.

ui_bugs.issue:
The [data-testid='image-toolbar'] block still does not appear when clicking a DOCX-imported image, even though the backend fix wrapped standalone images in

and ProseMirror now DOES apply the NodeSelection (img.ProseMirror-selectednode class is present in the DOM after click — this is new/positive behaviour vs iter45). Root cause has shifted: it is now a React re-render issue. useEditor() from @tiptap/react in LegalDocEditor.jsx has an onUpdate callback but no onSelectionUpdate — Tiptap's React binding does not force a re-render on NodeSelection changes by default. Evidence: after clicking the image the img.ProseMirror-selectednode ProseMirror decoration is present (proving the click DID create a NodeSelection on the image node), but the React toolbar block guarded by {editor.isActive('image') && (...)} never mounts. Concurrently, the table toolbar (guarded by editor.isActive('table')) stays mounted from an earlier text-selection-in-table state — further evidence React re-renders aren't being triggered by the selection transaction. Recommended fix (in /app/frontend/src/components/contracts/LegalDocEditor.jsx line 120 useEditor config): add either onSelectionUpdate: () => setForce(v => v+1) with a small useState counter, OR migrate the two contextual toolbars (image + table) to useEditorState({editor, selector: ({editor}) => ({isImage: editor.isActive('image'), isTable: editor.isActive('table'), imgAttrs: editor.getAttributes('image')})}) so they subscribe to selection changes. The DOCX-side backend fix is fully correct and should be kept — the remaining work is purely on the React binding.

critical_code_review_comments:
contract_docx_pipeline._wrap_standalone_images() correctly picks bare block-level and wraps in

. Its heuristic (400-char look-behind counting

/<\p>) correctly leaves the paragraph-header logo AND the in-table-cell decorator image alone on the real Paloma DOCX (4 imgs → 2 wrapped, 2 skipped). Two new unit tests (test_standalone_image_wrapped_in_paragraph, test_image_inside_paragraph_left_alone) cover the branches. This part is production-ready.

LegalDocEditor.jsx useEditor() is missing an onSelectionUpdate callback — this is why NodeSelection-driven toolbars don't appear. In Tiptap v3 the React binding only re-renders on doc changes (via onUpdate), not on pure selection transitions. The two contextual toolbars in this file rely on editor.isActive() which is selection-sensitive, so they need explicit subscription. Suggested minimal patch: add `onSelectionUpdate: () => setSelTick(t => t+1)` next to the existing onUpdate, and declare const [selTick, setSelTick] = useState(0) in the component. Alternative: import { useEditorState } from '@tiptap/react' and read {isImage, isTable} through it.

As a general architectural note: the same missing-selection-re-render pattern will silently break future NodeSelection-based UI (e.g. placeholder chip focus states, page-break drag handles) — worth fixing at the useEditor site once, not per-consumer.

rca of the issue:
Two-layer problem. LAYER 1 (fixed): iter45 reported that DOCX-imported tags were emitted as bare block-level siblings of

/, which made them NOT selectable in ProseMirror. Main agent added contract_docx_pipeline._wrap_standalone_images() to wrap every bare in

. Verified working — the wrap IS present in the persisted content_html (wrapCount=2 in the API response) and, critically, ProseMirror now DOES apply NodeSelection when the image is clicked (img.ProseMirror-selectednode class appears in the DOM). LAYER 2 (new): The React toolbar in LegalDocEditor.jsx is conditionally rendered on editor.isActive('image'), which changes on selection transitions. Tiptap v3's useEditor() hook only forces a React re-render when the document changes (via onUpdate), not when the selection changes (which would require onSelectionUpdate or useEditorState). Because there's no re-render subscription for selection, the toolbar block stays mounted-or-unmounted based on whatever the last document-change render said, and never flips when you click into or out of an image. Fix: add `onSelectionUpdate: () => forceUpdate()` (or switch the toolbar conditional to useEditorState) in the useEditor config at LegalDocEditor.jsx:120. Reproduction: (1) upload /tmp/paloma.docx via UI, (2) wait for editor, (3) click cover-page peacock image, (4) observe img.ProseMirror-selectednode class IS applied but [data-testid='image-toolbar'] is NOT in the DOM. Mitigation until fix: none — the image toolbar simply doesn't appear for imported images in the current build.
